title: Send, as storyboards
tagline: A file handed over, one panel at a time.
blurb: How send.sgit.ai works, drawn: for everyone, the four things a person does (send a file, say a token aloud, keep files in a vault, keep the keys); under the hood, what the bytes look like, the two kinds of API, how an agent hands a result over, and what can go wrong. Each board links to the page where you can do it for real.

shelves.title: For everyone
shelves.note: No cryptography required: what you do, what the other person sees, and what the server never sees.

shelves.title: Under the hood
shelves.note: For the engineer and the agent: the bytes, the two APIs, a hand-over by an agent, and the six ways it fails.

quotes: Every line a character says is the storyboard's, not a quote, and is marked not_a_quote; evidence panels quote this site's pages word for word, which the build checks against the page sources.
